normal.text: Are you here for one video, or is that never true?
Is this three minutes, or is this an hour?
Are you scrolling instead of resting?

annoyed.text: Again? Are you back because the feed refilled?
annoyed.yes: It did, and here I am

annoyed.text: You said one. Are you forty videos past that yet?
annoyed.no: No, one, and I'll close it

annoyed.text: Are you watching, or just being kept?

brutal.text: Are you about to lose another hour to fifteen-second nothing?
Are you digging for a bottom this feed doesn't have?
Scrolling, then regret, then more scrolling. Are you starting the loop again?
